items.why: Truist raised its price target to $1,000 from $763 on Tuesday, citing optimism around Meta's Muse Wonder AI model and upcoming earnings.
The fear gauge ticked up as chip stocks slid and tech stayed under pressure amid worries about AI valuations.
Bitcoin bounced back above $83,000 after an early dip below $81,000 as a sharp selloff in Korean chip stocks rattled risk appetite.
Shares slipped as investors await Tesla's Oct. 21 earnings, with focus on EV demand, robotaxi progress, and margins.

market_note: Nasdaq futures stayed soft while the Dow held up better on bank earnings.
summary: Stocks were mixed at midday, with megacap winners like Meta offsetting weakness in tech and chips. Bank earnings are in focus as investors look ahead to inflation data later this week.
